blocks.text: Blockchain technology ki innovations (nayi cheezein aur naye tareeqe), jinhein Blockchain 2.0 kaha jata hai, basic cryptocurrency se aage nayi aur behtar khoobiyan laati hain. Blockchain 2.0 mein smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps) aur behtar scalability shamil hain.

Smart contracts khud chalne wale (self-executing) contracts hain jin ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain. Pehle se tay conditions (shartein) poori hote hi yeh contract ki shartein khud execute kar dete hain, is liye intermediary ki zaroorat kam ho jati hai.

Misal (Example): real estate (jaidad) mein smart contracts property ke len den ko automatic bana sakte hain. Jab tamam conditions, jaise payment aur ownership (malik hona) ki verification (jaanch kar pakka karna), poori ho jayein to contract khud chal jata hai: ownership khareedar ko aur raqam bechne wale ko transfer ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain 2.0 basic cryptocurrency se aage kya laata hai (exercise MCQ 10)? Blockchain 2.0 aur us ki advanced features bataiye (exercise long question 6).
blocks.explanation: MCQ 10: (b) decentralized applications aur smart contracts. Blockchain 2.0 sirf currency ke len den se aage barh kar blockchain par programs chalata hai: smart contracts (code mein likhi shartein jo khud chalti hain, maslan jaidad ki transfer), dApps (aisi applications jo kisi ek company ke server ki bajaye blockchain par chalti hain), aur behtar scalability (zyada transactions sambhalna).

items: Blockchain 2.0: smart contracts, dApps, enhanced scalability.
Smart contract: conditions poori hote hi khud chalna (jaidad ki misal).
